title: Deployed .env values are still interpolated and mis-read: _format_env (deployer_ssh.py:1114) never quotes $, so a secret consumed through ${KEY} in spec env (e.g. evolution-api DATABASE_CONNECTION_URI: ${DATABASE_URL}) or through env_file only (.env.owner) loses everything after a $; and the naive hub .env reader for from_env (orchestrator/__init__.py:435-442) keeps surrounding quotes, while from_file keeps a trailing newline. Found by the W-80aed026 design critiques.
